notes: All speed comparisons use quiet same-binary cases within this allocation.
The diagnostic run is separate from the six quiet repetitions.
Stage and native counter sums describe local rank work, not global elapsed time.
A single diagnostic run cannot promote a faster configuration.

enhanced_fixture_validation.scope: Separate allocation, identical production library source; distinct partial/noncontiguous child updates and HODLR/DenseMPI/sequential Dense children.

diagnostic_native_rank0.scope_context: All solver.factor extraction calls, including calls outside GPU-host-panel callbacks. Keep separate from the filtered callback table.
diagnostic_native_rank0.semantics: Entry counters are per-call cumulative deltas; native_total is a per-call absolute wrapper timer. Traverse can include GPU row downloads. Redistribution excludes its preceding barrier.

historical_diagnostic_table.context: Only complete same-rank intervals inside prepare.host_panels during solver.factor; backend-log wall is labeled separately.
historical_diagnostic_table.all_factor_context: Includes extraction outside GPU-host-panel callbacks; do not divide by callback envelope wall.
historical_diagnostic_table.note: Descriptive only; different executables/allocations and native batch counts. Times are not pooled with the six same-binary quiet cases.

build_settings.compact_output: child-local 1x1 relay then one parent exchange

fixture.cases: distinct partial child updates; HODLR/DenseMPI/sequential Dense children; compact0/1; original+children+currentSchur

recommendation.scope: Matched 200-cubed16MPI/16GPU/four-node factor and factor-plus-solve; 100-cubed is a smoke comparison only.

baseline.scope_context: ALL solver.factor extraction calls, including calls outside GPU prepare.host_panels windows. Do not divide these native totals by GPU-host-panel callback wall.

inside_gpu_host_panel_callbacks.scope_context: Only complete same-rank intervals contained in prepare.host_panels during solver.factor; OMP1.

compact.scope_context: ALL solver.factor extraction calls, including calls outside GPU prepare.host_panels windows. Do not divide these native totals by GPU-host-panel callback wall.

inside_gpu_host_panel_callbacks.scope_context: Only complete same-rank intervals contained in prepare.host_panels during solver.factor; OMP1.

limitations: Different executable and allocation from prior diagnostic; native query counts differ. These diagnostic stages are descriptive and not pooled with the matched quiet speed trials.
Native EntryComm and framework collectives include packing/waiting; removing an exchange can move waits elsewhere.
Only rows fully inside same-rank prepare.host_panels intervals belong to callback fractions. All-factor totals are separate.
No baseline payload instrumentation was available, so new payload bytes do not establish a byte reduction.

artifact_policy: Logs, job folders, snapshots and build directories remain locally ignored and are excluded from the commit.
